source.prompt: Which CRM works best for a 10-person B2B sales team?
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
For a 10-person B2B sales team, there is no single "best" CRM—the ideal choice depends entirely on your team's core GTM (go-to-market) strategy: **inside sales vs. high-touch account management vs. rapid pipeline tracking**. 

| CRM | Best For | Typical Monthly Cost (10 Seats) | Key Strengths | Potential Drawbacks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pipedrive** | Visual pipeline management & fast rep adoption | ~$390–$590/mo | Extremely clean visual deal stages, high rep adoption, low setup effort. | Light built-in marketing tools; relies on integrations for complex lead scoring. |
| **Close** | High-volume outbound (cold calling & email sequences) | ~$490–$990/mo | Built-in power dialer, multi-channel automated outreach, native SMS/email sequences. | Can get expensive for small teams; overkill if sales are mostly field or relationship-driven. |
| **HubSpot (Sales Hub)** | Inbound lead management & sales/marketing alignment | ~$200–$1,000+/mo | Unmatched ecosystem, native content/marketing integration, highly scalable. | Price jumps sharply when moving from Starter to Professional tiers. |
| **Salesflare** | Relationship selling with zero manual data entry | ~$290–$490/mo | Automatically logs emails, meetings, and contacts directly from Gmail/Outlook. | Less customizability for enterprise-level reporting or hyper-complex pipelines. |

---

**Recommendations**

* **Choose Pipedrive** if your reps prioritize clear deal tracking, quick pipeline updates, and low admin overhead.
* **Choose Close** if your 10 reps spend all day on the phone or running cold email outbound campaigns.
* **Choose HubSpot** if marketing drives the majority of your leads and you need marketing + sales unified on one platform.
* **Choose Salesflare** if your account executives hate logging activity and you sell high-value B2B deals requiring deep email/meeting context tracking.

*(Avoid Salesforce Enterprise at this size unless you have a dedicated, full-time admin—it routinely bogs down 10-person teams in configuration overhead).*
